component_rules.buttons: Square or slight rounding (rounded-md max). High contrast (black bg, white text for primary). Solid borders for secondary.
component_rules.inputs: Generous padding, large text. The main query input should be borderless with just a thick bottom border, text-2xl or text-3xl. Focus state must have a crisp 2px black bottom border.
component_rules.cards: Flat design. No soft drop shadows. Use 1px solid border (#E4E4E7) and stark background (#FFFFFF or #FAFAFA).
component_rules.agent_stream_panel: Use IBM Plex Mono. Show timestamps. Auto-scroll to bottom. Use specific colors for agent state badges.
component_rules.report_view: Prose typography, rich markdown support. Clear H1, H2 hierarchy. Inline citation badges as small pill-shaped superscripts.

interactions.hover: Hover states must have higher contrast. Buttons invert or shift to darker grey.
interactions.loading: Typewriter effect for streaming text. Blinking cursor at the end of the active stream.
interactions.transitions: Fast, crisp transitions (150ms ease-out). No bouncy or slow animations.

sections.name: Sidebar
sections.content: Brand logo, 'New Research' button, Session History list (Recent Queries) using truncated text.

sections.name: Main Canvas - Empty State
sections.content: Massive centered text input for the research query. Subdued example chips below ('Investigate recent advancements in solid-state batteries', 'Summarize Q4 2025 AI agent market trends').

sections.name: Main Canvas - Active State
sections.content: Bento split. Left/Top (col-span-12 lg:col-span-4): Live Agent Stream (terminal-like). Right/Bottom (col-span-12 lg:col-span-8): Final Synthesized Report, incrementally building. References list below report as numbered cards.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install lucide-react for icons (MagnifyingGlass, History, Download, Copy, BrainCircuit).
Install Framer Motion for the typewriter stream effect and subtle reveal of the report sections.
Implement the layout with a fixed sidebar and scrollable main content.
For the main query input, do NOT use standard Shadcn Input; build a custom large, border-bottom-only textarea or input that auto-expands.
Ensure the Live Stream panel uses monospace font, shows timestamps, and auto-scrolls to the newest entry.
For the final report, use a typography plugin or robust custom prose styles to format Markdown.
Implement inline citations as small rounded badges that link to the references list at the bottom.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='query-input', data-testid='submit-research', data-testid='history-item', data-testid='export-md').
Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the main complex bento grids, avoid Shadcn Card if it restricts the layout flexibility.
